## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and a short path that can be expanded into an absolute path using the skill roots table.
### Skill roots
- `r0` = `/Users/me/.codex/skills`
- `r1` = `/Users/me/.agents/skills`
- `r2` = `/Users/me/.codex/skills/.system`
- `r3` = `/Users/me/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-bundled`
- `r4` = `/Users/me/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-primary-runtime`
- `r5` = `/Users/me/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-primary-runtime/spreadsheets/26.905.11957/skills`
- `r6` = `/Users/me/.codex/plugins/cache/t3-pstack/t3-pstack/2.0.0/skills`
### Available skills
- imagegen: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups (file: r2/imagegen/SKILL.md)
- babysit: Drive an open tester-army/e2e PR through conflicts, review bots, and CI until it is green with every thread handled, then label it Ready for (file: r1/babysit/SKILL.md)
- find-skills: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can (file: r0/find-skills/SKILL.md)
- pdf:pdf: Read, create, inspect, render, and verify PDF files where visual layout matters, including fillable AcroForms. Use Poppler rendering plus Py (file: r4/pdf/26.905.11957/skills/pdf/SKILL.md)
- bank-reconcile: Reconcile a budgeting app against real bank statements through an Open Finance MCP. Use when the user asks for a re (file: r1/bank-reconcile/SKILL.md)
- spreadsheets:Spreadsheets: Use skill when user requests to create, modify, analyze, visualize, or work with spreadsheet files (`.xlsx`, `.xls`, `.csv`, `.tsv`) or Googl (file: r5/spreadsheets/SKILL.md)
- t3-pstack:tdd: Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test, OR when the bug has an obvious cheap local test targ (file: r6/tdd/SKILL.md)
- tdd: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integrati (file: r1/tdd/SKILL.md)
</skills_instructions>
